def tabulateFrom {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) : Nat → Nat → List α

  | start, n + 1 => f start :: tabulateFrom f (start + 1) n

def karatsubaCoeff (a b : List Int) (k : Nat) : Int :=

    if i < a.length ∧ k - i < b.length then
      acc + a.getD i 0 * b.getD (k - i) 0
    else

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

         if i < a.length ∧ k - i < b.length then
           acc + a.getD i 0 * b.getD (k - i) 0
         else acc) 0
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem tabulateFrom_length {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (start n : Nat) :
    (tabulateFrom f start n).length = n := by
